scenario_description:
Objective: Get the paid Courtyard Room opened in time for a planned story-circle setup window.
Emerging Need: The room-entry attempt begins on site, then stops when the keypad rejects the reservation code and the needed setup materials remain locked inside.
Decision Context: Prior access notes identify the appropriate support route, cutoff, and privacy-safe information for this kind of paid reservation failure.
Consequence: Timely help could restore the same setup attempt before guests arrive; once support monitoring ends, the room can no longer be prepared as intended.

parameter.body: Your Riverside story circle reservation CY-14 for Sunday, October 18, 2026 is confirmed for 6:30-8:30 p.m. in the Courtyard Room. Setup access begins at 5:45 p.m. The rental receipt will post separately.
